summary: First MVP smoke pass on ISP CRM (NetOps CRM). Backend and frontend validated end-to-end with admin owner credentials. All 17 requested checks passed. Backend: auth, dashboard KPIs, plans CRUD, NAP capacity guard, clients+payment_day+next_due_date logic, payment advance vs promise, leads, extras, whatsapp (outgoing+simulate-incoming), tasks (create + PATCH to done), devices (mikrotik/olt), onus derived data, disconnected list, config GET/PUT thresholds, users create technician, RBAC (technician 403 on /users, 200 on /clients), owner cannot delete own account. Frontend: login redirects to Dashboard, sidebar shows exactly 14 nav items (dashboard, clientes, planes, pagos, leads, extras, mapa, olt, mikrotik, desconectados, whatsapp, tareas, usuarios, configuracion), all routes load without page-level errors. WhatsApp, OLT and Mikrotik are correctly MOCKED per spec.
passed: POST /api/auth/login owner returns JWT + user
GET /api/stats/dashboard returns KPIs (total_clients, active, suspended, offline, new, revenue_this_month, open_leads)
Plans CRUD: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE all OK
POST /api/nap-boxes creates NAP with lat/lng/capacity
POST /api/clients creates client with plan_id + nap_box_id, returns next_due_date computed from payment_day
NAP capacity guard: second client to capacity=1 NAP returns 400 with 'está llena'
POST /api/payments advances next_due_date one month and sets status=active
POST /api/payments with is_promise=true does NOT advance next_due_date
POST /api/leads with type=installation OK
POST /api/extras category=iptv OK
POST /api/whatsapp/messages (outgoing) + /simulate-incoming (incoming) OK
POST /api/tasks + PATCH stage=done OK
POST /api/devices for mikrotik and olt OK
GET /api/onus returns derived data (power_dbm, rx_mbps, tx_mbps, ip_address) per client
GET /api/disconnected returns array
PUT/GET /api/config updates onu thresholds and disconnect_alert_minutes
POST /api/users as owner creates technician
RBAC: technician gets 403 on POST /api/users, gets 200 on POST /api/clients
Self-delete guard: owner DELETE /api/users/{own_id} returns 400 'No puedes eliminar tu propia cuenta'
Frontend: login flow redirects to Dashboard, KPIs render real values
Sidebar shows all 14 modules with correct data-testid nav-* attributes
Routes /clientes /planes /mapa /olt /pagos /tareas /usuarios /configuracion all load without page errors
notes: Console 401s observed prior to login on /login page are expected (unauthenticated probes) and disappear after auth.
WhatsApp, OLT, Mikrotik endpoints are simulated (per MVP spec) - working as designed.
